The majority of the CME is missed in STEREO A COR2 due to a real-time data gap. There are two notable features of this CME - a bright, narrow, bulk-like feature and a faint, wide, shock-like feature. The fainter shock feature is only seen in SOHO LASCO C2/C3 and GOES CCOR-1. The source of this CME may be related to field line movement beyond the ENE limb in GOES SUVI 284 beginning around 2026-11-22T02:40Z. If this beyond-limb activity is the source of this CME, then there is some significant westward deflection based on triangulated measurements.
